findings.what: Transformer is a passive magnetic component with well-defined connections. No active circuitry to review.
Primary connections (PRI_P, PRI_N) verified against half-bridge switch node and ground.
Secondary center-tap topology verified: SEC_A and SEC_B to SR FETs, SEC_CT to output rail.
No pin number assignments possible - custom part with undefined pinout until manufactured.
EXTERNAL SOURCING REQUIRED: This component cannot be sourced from JLCPCB. Board assembly will be incomplete without transformer consignment or hand-assembly.
Turns ratio (4:1:1) matches voltage transformation requirement (48V → 12V).
Magnetizing inductance (110µH) calculated and verified against LLC resonant tank design.
Isolation voltage (1500V) meets IEC 60950-1 basic insulation for SELV output.

notes: Transformer connections are fixed by topology. No changes possible without redesigning the LLC converter architecture. All electrical connections verified against reference circuit (TI SLUA697A). Physical/magnetic design parameters documented in transformer_calculations.md and values.json.
